The tier 2 read-back completeness check in [`process`](file:///work/clinicbench/scorer.py#L394-L405) unconditionally requires `{"action", "slot", "doctor"}` for every write and adds `"cost"` for every `"book"` write:

- **Cancel writes**: `need` requires `"slot"` and `"doctor"`, whereas a cancel read-back only contains `"action"` and `"appt"` (see [`Prober._change`](file:///work/clinicbench/stubs.py#L339-L341)).
- **Covered bookings**: `need` requires `"cost"` whenever `action == "book"` regardless of `basis`, whereas covered bookings have `"cost": None` (see [`Prober._book`](file:///work/clinicbench/stubs.py#L399-L400)), which is filtered out by `v is not None`.

Because this is a bug in the scorer (instrument code, not the driver), it is a `fix`.

Fixed the tier 2 read-back completeness check in [`process`](file:///work/clinicbench/scorer.py#L399-L404) inside [`clinicbench/scorer.py`](file:///work/clinicbench/scorer.py):

- For `cancel` writes, `need` is now `{"action", "appt"}` instead of requiring `"slot"` and `"doctor"`.
- For `book` writes, `"cost"` is now required only when `basis == "self_pay"` (covered bookings require `{"action", "slot", "doctor"}`).
- `move` writes continue to require `{"action", "slot", "doctor"}`.
